title: State of Retail Trading Algorithms 2026
description:
Aggregate statistics from Prismatic Algos' review of 16,277 publicly documented retail trading algorithms (snapshot 2026-11-14): strategy-family distribution, technical-indicator crowding, documented risk-control gaps (stop-loss, take-profit, position sizing, unbounded grid/martingale) and evidence quality (Sharpe reporting, sample size, out-of-sample testing). Aggregates only; no strategy text or code.

Reuse requires attribution and a link to https://prismaticalgos.com.
